# TokenCallbackHandler

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/04c494d92ce87df3b9ba252c17541e08e28fdf97/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/handler/TokenCallbackHandler.sol)

**Inherits:** [ERC1155TokenReceiver](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/interfaces/interface.ERC1155TokenReceiver), [ERC777TokensRecipient](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/interfaces/interface.ERC777TokensRecipient), [ERC721TokenReceiver](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/interfaces/interface.ERC721TokenReceiver), [IERC165](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/interfaces/interface.IERC165)

**Title:** Default Callback Handler - Handles supported tokens' callbacks, allowing Safes receiving these tokens.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Functions

<a id="onerc1155received-address-address-uint256-uint256-bytes"></a>

### onERC1155Received

Handles ERC1155 Token callback.
return Standardized onERC1155Received return value.

```solidity
function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external pure override returns (bytes4);
```

| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _ | `address` |  |

| _ | `uint256` |  |
| _ | `uint256` |  |
| _ | `bytes` |  |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bytes4` |  |

<a id="supportsinterface-bytes4"></a>

### supportsInterface

Implements ERC165 interface support for ERC1155TokenReceiver, ERC721TokenReceiver and IERC165.

```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view virtual override returns (bool);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| interfaceId | `bytes4` | Id of the interface. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bool` | if the interface is supported. |
